summary.en: Today’s focus is an LC–HRMS workflow connecting signal extraction, feature construction and putative metabolite annotation.

en: Today’s focus is an LC–HRMS workflow connecting signal extraction, feature construction and putative metabolite annotation.
Further reading should examine cross-instrument generalization, parameter dependence and benchmark conditions. Coverage is incomplete because some journal and full-text sources were inaccessible.

值得进一步核查的是跨仪器泛化、参数依赖与基准比较条件。部分期刊和全文入口访问受限，本次覆盖不完整。

papers.title: Emzing: A Deep Learning-Enabled Software Suite for End-to-End Analysis of High-Resolution LC-MS Metabolomics Data

commentary.zh: Emzing 将深度学习峰检测、自适应噪声估计、保留时间对齐与图分组整合为 LC–HRMS 代谢组分析流程，并提供谱库匹配的 MSI 2 级暂定注释。作者摘要报告基准改进及逾 110 个公共数据集再分析，但本次未取得全文，无法核查具体比较条件或把暂定注释视为确证身份。
commentary.en: Emzing integrates deep-learning peak detection, adaptive noise estimation, retention-time alignment and graph grouping for LC–HRMS metabolomics, with MSI level-2 putative library annotations. The abstract reports benchmark improvements and over 110 reprocessed public datasets, but full-text comparison conditions were unavailable for assessment and putative matches are not confirmed identities.
